comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
This is ship decoration introduced in Chapter 2 of Lost Memories. In the chapter you can add decoration like lantern, gondola, even national flag to your ship (The ship will get 'fashion slot' similar when you layering equipment) From what i heard, these decorations have its small effect. Unfortunately, it will take some time for Maris to receive this content.. we still need to deal with Chapter 1 first.

At the main page of ivyro you can see 'Deco' under the selection in top. There you can see all possible lists of ship decorations so far.
